title: Suppli Italiani (Italian Fried Rice Balls)
description: A classic Italian snack made with fried risotto balls filled with mozzarella and tomato sauce. Perfect for a quick bite.
instructions: Cook the risotto rice according to package instructions.
In a separate saucepan, heat the bechamel sauce over low heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked risotto rice, bechamel sauce, mozzarella, parmesan, and eggs. Mix well.
Add the flour to the mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the suppli until they are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Drain the suppli on paper towels and serve hot.
